title: Intervention and the Cold War in Central America
goal: I can explain the role of the United States in Central America, using sin embargo and no obstante.

items: I can explain what the United States did in Central America and what its critics said.
I can say who the Contras were and who helped them.
I can explain what the Iran-Contra scandal was.
I can use sin embargo and no obstante to contrast two ideas.
I can use the new words for intervention, weapons and scandal.
